zh: 深色矩形区域包围着一条中央浅色带。
浅色带在上部突然扩展成宽大的近似菱形区域。
中部收窄后又向左下方重新扩展。
中央附近有小型深色斑点打断浅色区域。
下端向左形成不规则的尖状突出。
图像反相和阈值化处理遮挡了原始表面边界。
en: A dark rectangular field fills the image around a pale central band.
The pale band widens sharply into a broad upper diamond-like area.
Its middle narrows and then widens again toward the lower left.
Small dark specks interrupt the pale region near the center.
The lower end forms an uneven pointed projection toward the left.
The image polarity and thresholding obscure the original surface boundary.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
